Frequently asked questions.

Have more questions or need help?

Contact support

How does Lumis work?

Upload your data or connect your database, and our AI analyzes it to recommend the best visualizations. You can customize any chart, then export or share with your team.

What data formats does Lumis support?

CSV, Excel, Google Sheets, and direct connections to databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, and BigQuery. We also integrate with business tools like Salesforce and HubSpot.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Lumis is designed for anyone who works with data, regardless of technical background. The AI handles the complex parts automatically.

How accurate are the AI recommendations?

Our AI is trained on millions of visualizations and follows data visualization best practices. You maintain full control to adjust or override any suggestion.

How long does it take to create a dashboard?

Most users create their first dashboard in under 10 minutes. Complex dashboards with multiple data sources typically take 30-45 minutes.
